m: 1. दिश् cl. 3. P. दिदेष्टि (Imper. दिदेष्टु, RV.; cl. 6. दिशति, ˚ते [later the only Pres. stem]; pf. दिदेश, दिदिशे; fut. देक्ष्यति, ˚ते [देष्टा, Siddh.]; aor. अदिक्षत्, ŚBr. &c.; अदिक्षि, अदिष्ट, RV.; inf. देष्टुम्, MBh. etc.; दिशे, RV.) to point out, show, exhibit, RV. viii, 82, 15; to produce, bring forward (as a witness in a court of justice), Mn. viii; to promote, effect, accomplish, Kir., i, 18; to assign, grant, bestow upon (dat. RV. ii, 41, 17; AV. xiv, 2, 13; gen. MBh. iii, 14278; xiii, 1843; loc. R. i, 2, 28); to pay (tribute), Hariv. 16061; to order, command, bid (inf.), Kir. v, 28 : Pass. दिश्यते, MBh. &c.: Caus. देशयति, ˚ते; aor. अदीदिशत्, to show, point out, assign, MBh.; R.; to direct, order, command, ib.; teach, communicate, tell, inform, confess, Buddh. : Desid. दिदिक्षति, ˚ते, to wish to show &c.: Intens. देदिष्टे, 3. pl. ˚शते, (p. f. pl. ˚शतीस्) to show, exhibit, manifest, RV.; to order, command, ib. : Pass. देदिश्यते, to show or approve one's self, AV.; VS.
दिश् [cf. Z. dis; Gk. δείκνυμι; Lat. dīco, in-dĭcare &c.; Goth. teihan; O. E. téon (fr. tíhan).]

2. दिश् f. quarter or region pointed at, direction, cardinal point, RV.; AV.; ŚBr. &c. (four in number, viz. प्राची, east; दक्षिणा, south; प्रतीची, west; and उदीची, north, AV. xv, 2, 1; ĀśvGṛ. iv, 8 &c.; Sometimes a 5th, ध्रुवा, AV. iii, 9, 15; ŚBr. ix, 4, 3, 10; and a 6th, ऊर्ध्वा, AV. iii, 27, 1; ŚBr. xiv, 6, 11, 5; and a 7th, व्य्-अध्वा, AV. iv, 40, l; ŚBr. ix, 5, 2, 8; but oftener 8 are given i.e. the 4 cardinal and the 4 intermediate quarters, S.E., S.W., N.W., and N.E., Mn. i, 13 [cf. उप-]; and even a 9th, and 10th, तिर्यक् or अधस् and ऊर्ध्वम्, ŚBr. vi, 2, 2, 34; MBh. i, 729; दिशाम् पति [cf. दिक्-पति below] = Soma, RV. ix, 113, 2, or = Rudra, VS. xvi, 17)

quarter, region, direction, place, part (pl., rarely sg. the whole world, e.g. दिशि दिशि, in all directions, everywhere, Bhartṛ. i, 86; दिग्भ्यस्, from every q˚, BhP. i, 15, 8 ; दिशो दिशस्, hither and thither, Pañc. ii, 116/117; दिशोऽवलोक्य, looking into the q˚ of the sky i.e. into the air, Ratn. iv, 4/5 दिशो ऽन्तात्, from the extremities of the world, ib., Introd. 6)
country, esp. foreign country, abroad (cf. दिग्-आगत and -लाभ, below)

3. दिश् a vulgar form for दृश्, to see, Pāṇ. i, 3, 1, Vārtt. 13, Pat.
a: दिश् — {c6c} U. (दिशति-ते, दिष्ट; desid. दिदिक्षति-ते) 1 To point out, show, exhibit, produce (as a witness); साक्षिणः संति मेत्युक्त्वा दिशेत्युक्तो दिशेन्न यः Ms. 8. 57, 52, 53. --2 To assign, allot; इष्टां गतिं तस्य सुरा दिशांति Mb. --3 To give, grant, bestow upon, deliver or make over to; बाणमत्रभवते निजं दिशन् Ki. 13. 68; R. 5. 30, 11, 2, 16. 72. --4 To pay (as tribute). --5 To consent to; R. 11. 49. --6 To direct, order, command. --7 To allow, permit; स्मर्तुं दिशंति न दिवः सुरसुंदरीभ्यः Ki. 5. 28. --Caus. (देशयति-ते) 1 To show, point out, allot, assign. --2 To teach, communicate, tell, inform. --3 To direct, order. --4 To confer, bestow.

दिश् — f. [दिशति ददात्पवकाशं दिश्-क्विप्] (Nom. sing. दिक्-ग्) 1 A direction, cardinal point, point of the compass, quarter of the sky; दिशः प्रसेदुर्मरुतो ववुः सुखाः R. 3. 14; दिशि दिशि किरति सजलकणजालं Gīt. 4. --2 (a) The mere direction of a thing, hint, indication (of the general lines); इति दिक् (often used by commentators &c.); इत्थं लौकिकशब्दानां दिङ्मात्रमिह दर्शितं Sk. (b) (Hence) Mode, manner, method; मुनेः पाठोक्तदिशा S. D.; दिगियं सूत्रकृता प्रदर्शिता; दासीसभं नृपसभं रक्षःसभमिमा दिशः Ak. --3 Region, space, place in general. --4 A foreign or distant region. --5 A point of view, manner of considering a subject. --6 A precept, order. --7 The number ‘ten’. --8 A side or party. --9 The mark of a bite. (N. B. In comp. दिश् becomes दिग् before words beginning with vowels and soft consonants, and दिक् before words beginning with hard consonants; e. g. दिगंबर, दिग्गज, दिक्पथ, दिक्करिन्, &c.) --Comp. --अंतः end of the direction or horizon, remote distance, remote place; Bv. 1. 2; Māl. 2. 9; R. 3. 4, 5. 67, 16. 87; नानादिगंतागता राजानः &c. --अंतरं {1} another direction. {2} the intermediate space, atmosphere, space. {3} a distant quarter, another or foreign country. --अंबर a. having only the directions for his clothing, stark naked, unclothed; दिगंबरत्वेन निवेदितं वसु Ku. 5. 72. --(रः) {1} a naked mendicant (of the Jaina or Buddha sect.). {2} a mendicant, an ascetic. {3} an epithet of (1) Śiva; (--2) Skanda. {4} darkness. --(री) an epithet of Durgā. --अंबरकः a naked mendicant (of the Jaina sect). --ईशः --ईश्वरः the regent of a quarer; Ku. 5. 53; see अष्टदिक्पाल. --कन्या, --कांता, --कामिनी a region of the sky (considered as a virgin). --करः {1} a youth, youthful man. {2} an epithet of Śiva. --करिका, --करी a young girl or woman. --करिन्, --गजः, --दंतिन्, --वारणः m. one of the eight elephants said to guard and preside over the eight cardinal points; (see अष्टदिग्गज); दिग्दंतिशेषाः ककुभश्चकार Vikr. 7. 1. --ग्रहणं observation of the quarters of the compass. --चक्रं {1} the horizon. {2} the whole world. --जयः, --विजयः ‘conquest of the directions,’ the conquest of various countries in all directions, conquest of the world; स दिग्विजयमव्याजवीरः स्मर इवाकरोत् Vikr. 4. 1. --तटं the horizon. --दर्शनं {1} showing merely the direction, pointing out only the general mode or manner. {2} a general outline or survey. {3} a compass. --दाहः preternatural redness of the horizon. --नागः {1} an elephant of the quarter of the compass; see दिग्गज. {2} N. of a poet said to be a contemporary of Kālidāsa. (This interpretation is based on Mallinātha's gloss on Me. 14 which is, however, very doubtful). --पतिः, --पालः the regent or guardian of a quarter; (for the names of the several regents, see अष्टदिक्पाल; cf. Ms. 5. 96; 7. 303. also). --पथः the surrounding region. --भागः a point of the compass, direction. --मंडलं = दिक्चक्रं q. v. --मात्रं the mere direction or indication. --मुखं any quarter or part of the sky; हरति मे हरिवाहनदिङ्मुखं V. 3. 6; Amaru. 5. --मोहः mistaking the way or direction. --वस्त्र a. stark naked, unclothed. --(स्त्रः) {1} a Jaina or Buddhist mendicant of the दिगंवर class. {2} an epithet of Śiva. --विभावित a. renowned or celebrated in all quarters.

fire, L.

a: दिग्ध — See under दिह्.

दिग्ध — p. p. [दिह्-क्त] 1 Smeared, anointed, daubed; हस्तावसृग्दिग्धौ Ms. 3. 132; R. 16. 15; दिग्धोऽमृतेन च विषेण च पक्ष्मलाक्ष्या गाढं निखात इव मे हृदये कटाक्षः Māl. 1. 29. --2 Soiled, defiled, polluted. --3 Poisoned, envenomed; Ku. 4. 25. --ग्धः 1 Oil, ointment. --2 Any oily substance or unguent. --3 Fire. --4 A poisoned arrow. --5 A story (true or fictitious.)

k.v: निरस्तः प्रहिते बाणे विषाक्ते दिग्धलिप्तकौ। तूणोपासङ्गतूणीरनिषङ्गा इषुधिर्द्वयोः॥
घ्राणघ्राते दिग्धलिप्ते समुदक्तोद्धृते समे। वेष्टितं  स्याद्वलयितं संवीतं रुद्धमावृतम्.।

m: दिग्ध-फल n. the point of a poisoned arrow, Kum. iv, 25.

दिग्ध—सह-शय mfn. lying in mud or along with any soiled person, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 15, Vārtt. 2, Pat.

दिग्—ईश (Var.) & दिग्—ईश्वर (MBh.), m. = दिक्-पति.

v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 indrAdO dikzAle 2 sUryyAdigrahe ca “digISvarA BAskaraSukraBOmA rAhvArkicandrajYasurArcitAH syuH” jyo॰ ta॰ digISAdayo'pyatra “digISavfndAMSaviBUti rISitA” nEza॰

v: pu॰ 7 ta॰ । si॰ Si॰ ukte diksTe aMSaBede yaTA “cakrAMSakANke kzitijAKyavftte prAksvastikABIzwa diSastu maDye । ye'MSAH sTitAste'tra digaMSakAKyAstajjyAtra digjyetyapare viBAge” si॰ Si॰ “kadAcidapyaBIzwadine yasmin kAle pracCakaH pfcCati tatra kAle'rkopari nyastasya digmaRqalasya kzitijasya ca sampAte yABIzwA dik tasyAH prAk svastikasya cAntare kzitijavftte ye'MSAste'tra digaMSakA jYeyAH । tezAM jyA digjyeti evaM paMScimamAge'pi” pra॰ mi॰

s: strI, (digambara + NIz .) durgA । digambarasya patnI । iti kulArRavaH ॥ nagne, tri । ityamaraH । 3 । 1 । 39 ॥ (yaTA, kAloDyAne । “mahAmeGapraBAM SyAmAM taTA cEva digambarIm ॥”)
m: दिग्—अम्बरी f. N. of Durgā, L. (cf. -वस्त्र and -वासस्)

s: puM, (digeva ambaraM vastraM yasya । ulaNgatvAt taTAtvam .) SivaH । kzapaRaH । (sa tu jEnaviSezaH । yaTA, paYcadaSyAm । 6 । 82 । “digambarA maDvamatvamAhurApAdamastakam । cEtanyavyAptisaMdfzwerAnaKAgraSruterapi ॥”) tamaH । iti medinI । re, 267 ॥ (nagne, tri । yaTA, paYcatantre । 5 । 14 । “ekAkI gfhasantyaktaH pARipAtro digambaraH । so'pi saMvAhyate loke tfzRayA paSya kOtukam ॥”)
v: pu॰ dikSUnyamambaraM yasya । 1 Sive 2 jEnaBede pu॰ tanmatamarhacCabde uktaprAyaM kiYcidatrADikamucyate । “digambarA maDyamatvamAhurApAdamastakam । cEtanyavyAptisaMdfzwerAnaKAgraSruterapi” । asya BAzA prAkftAntaraBedaminnA mAgaDI । asya svarUpantu galanmalapaNkena picCilabIBatsaduzprekzyadehacCaviluYcitacikuro muktavasano veSadurdarSanaH SiKiSiKaRqapicCikAhastaH iti । etanmatasidDaM jIvasya maDyamaparimARatvaM SA॰ sU॰ BAzyayornirAkftaM yaTA “evaYcAtmA'kAtrsnyam” sU॰ । “SarIraparimARo hi jIva ityArhatA manyante । SarIraparimARatAyAM ca satyAmakftsno'sarvagataH paricCinna Atmetyato GawAdivadanityatvamAtmanaH prasajyeta । SarIrARAYcAnavasTitaparimARatvAnmanuzyajIvo manuzyaSarIraparimARo BUtvA punaH kenacit karmavipAkeRa hastijanma prApnuvanna kftsnaM hastiSarIraM vyApnuyAt, puttikAjanma ca prApnuvanna kftsna puttikASarIre sammIyeta । samAna eza ekasminnapi janmani kOmArayOvanasTAvirezu dozaH । syAdetat, anantAvayavI jIvastasya ta evAvayavA alpe SarIre saNkuceyurmahati ca vikASeyuriti । tezAM punaranantAnAM jIvAvayavAnAM samAnadeSatvaM pratihanyeta vA na veti vaktavyam । pratiGAte tAvannAnantAvayavAH paricCinne deSe sammIyeran । apratiGAte'pyekAvayavadeSatvopapatteH sarvezAmavayavAnAM praTimAnupapatteH jIvasyARumAtratvaprasaNgaH syAt । api ca SarIramAtraparicCinnAnAM jIvAvayavAnAmAnantyaM notprekzitumapi Sakyam aTa paryyAyeRa vfhacCarIrapratipattO ca kecijjIvAvayavA upagacCanti tanuSarIrapratipattO ca kecidapagacCanti ityucyeta tatrApyucyate” BA॰ । “na ca paryyAyAdapyaviroDI vikArAdiByaH” sU॰ । “na ca paryyAyeRApyavayavopagamApagamAByAmetaddehaparimARatva jIvasyAviroDenopapAdayituM Sakyate kutaH vikArAdidozaprasaNgAt । avayavopagamApagamAByAM hyaniSamApUryyamARasyApakzIyamARasya ca jIvasya vikriyAvattvaM tAvadaparihAryyaM vikriyAvattve ca carmAdivadanityatvaM prasajyeta tataSca banDamokzaByupagamo bADyeta, karmAzwakaparivezwitasya jIvasyAlAbUvat saMsArasAgare nimagnasya banDanocCedAdUrdDvagAmitvaM BavatIti । kiYcAnyadAgacCatAmapagacCatAYcAvayavAnAmAgamopADiDarmavattvAdevAnAtmatvaM SarIrAdivat । tataScAvyavasTitaH kaScidavayavI Atmeti syAt, na ca sa nirUpayituM Sakyate ayamasAviti । kiYcAnyadAgacCantaScEte jIvAvayavAH kutaH prAdurBavanti apagacCantaSca kva vA lIyanta iti vaktavyam । na hi BUteByaH prAdurBaveyuH BUtezu ca lIyeran aBOtikatvAjjIvasya । nApi kaScidanyaH sADAraRo'sADAraRo vA jIvAnAmavayavADAro nirUpyate pramARABAvAt । kiYcAnyadanavaDftasvarUpaScEvaM satyAtmA syAt AgacCatAmapagacCatAYcAvayavAnAmaniyataparimARatvAt, ata evamAdidozaprasaNgAt na paryyAyeRApyavayavopagamApagamAvAtmana ASrayituM Sakyete । aTa vA pUrveRa sUtreRa SarIraparimARasyAtmana upacitApacitaSarIrAntarapratipattAvakAtrsnyaprasaYjanadvAreRAnityatAyAM coditAyAM punaH paryyAyeRa parimARAnavasTAne'pi srotaHsantAnanityatA nyAyenAtmano nityatA syAt, yaTA raktapawAdInAM vijYAnAnavasTAne'pi tatsantAnanityatA tadvadvisicAnAM (vivasanAnAm) apItyASaNkyAnena sUtreRottarattacyate । santAnasya tAvadavastutve nErAtmyavAdaprasaNgaH, vastutve'pyAtmano vikArAdidozaprasaNgAdasya pakzasyAnupapattiriti” । 3nagne tri॰ “digambaratvena niveditaM vasu” । kumA॰ striyAM gOrA॰ NIz । “taTA cEva digambarI” kAlIDyAnam “hrIrUpA'pi digambarI trijagatAM mAtA'pi sadyOvanA” kAlIstavaH । digevAmbaram । 4 digrUpe ambare dik ca ambaraYca samA॰ dva॰ । 5 digAkASasamahAre ca na॰ “AcCAditAyatadigambaramuccakErgAm mAGaH । 6 tamasi na॰ medi॰ svArTe ka । digambaraka kzapaRake hArA॰ ।
m: दिग्—अम्बर mfn. ‘sky clothed’ i.e. quite naked, Bhartṛ. iii, 90; Pañc. v, 14

N. of Śiva or Skanda, L.
of a grammarian, Gaṇar.
darkness, L.

v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 diSAmante । digantaviSrAntaraTohi tatsutaH “BujArjitAnAM ca digantasampadAm” raGuH । 2 SAstrIyajYAnakarmayutajanADizWitamaDyadeSAdatirikte deSe ca

a quarter of the sky

v: na॰ diNnimittaM grahARAm balam । lagnAdO sTitagrahARAM digBedaniyamite bale yaTAha jyotize “lagne sOmyasurAcAryyO kujArkO daSame taTA । dyUne sOriScaturTe tu sitendU digbalAnvitO” । atra koRadigbalitvanirAsAya lagnadaSamadyUnacaturTapadEH pUrvadakziRapaScimottaradigupAdanam । lagne sTitO buDagurU pUrvadigbalinO yatI rASInAmudayo lagnaM udayastu pUrvadiSyeva Bavati । lagnAt daSame sTitO kujArkO dakziRadigbalinO yato lagnAddaSamarASireva dakziRadiSi tizWati । saptame sTitO SaniH paScimadigvalI yato lagnAt saptamarASirastameti । astaYca paScimadiSyeva Bavati । taTA lagnAccaturTe sTitO SukracandrO uttaradigbalinO yato lagnAccaturTarASirevonaradigBage tizWati । tadvalAnvito graho digbalItyucyate” etaccAyurdAyAdizu balagaRanopayogi । yAtrAdizu yaTAsTitapUrvAdyapekzayEva grahARAM digbalitvaM jyo॰ ta॰ uktaM yaTA॰ “prAcyAM sOmyasurAcAryO yAmyAM BAskaraBUmijO । pratyak sOrirudIcyAntu sitendU dinabalAnvitO” ।

pu॰ digbalamastyasya ini । 1 diNnimittabalayukte gfhe digbalaSabde dfSyam । 2 tAdfSe rASimede ca “EndryAM mAnuzarASayastu paSavoyAmye savIryyA alirvAruRyAM balayuk taTEva balinaH pAnIyajAScottare” jyo॰ ta॰

m: दिग्—बन्ध m. = ग्रहन, Kathās. lxxiii, 116.

v: pu॰ diSAM dAhaH । vf॰ sa॰ 21 a॰ ukte utpAtaBede tacCuBASuBAdikaM tatroktaM yaTA “dAho diSAM rAjaBayAya pIto deSasya nASAya hutASavarRaH । yaScAruRaH syAdapasavyakAyuH Sasyasya nASaM sa karIti dfzwaH । yo'tIva dIptyA kurute prakASaM CAyAmapi vyaYjayate'rkavat yaH । rAjYo mahadvedayate BayaM saH SastraprakopaM kzatajAnurUpaH । prAk kzatriyARAM sanareSvarARAM prAgdakziRe SilpikumArapIqA । yAgge sahogrEH puruzEstu vESyA dUtAH punarBUpramadASca koRe । paScAnu SUdrAH kfzijIvinaSca cOrAsturaNgEH saha vAyudiksTe । pIqAM vrajantyuttarataSca viprAH pAzARqano bARijakARa SArvyAm(ESAnyAm) । naBaH prasannaM vimalAni BAni pradakziRaM vAti saMdAmatiSca । diSAM ca dAhaH kanakAvadAto hitAya lokasya sapArTivasya” ।

s: puM, (diSo gajaH .) diGastI । yaTA, -- “ErAvataH puRqarIko vAmanaH kumudo'YjanaH । puzpadantaH sArvvaBOmaH supratIkaSca diggajAH ॥” ityamaraH । 1 । 3 । 4 ॥ ete krameRa pUrvvAdyazwadiSAM hastinaH ॥

दिग्—इभ m. = दिक्-करिन्, BhP. v, 14, 39.

v: na॰ 6 ta॰ si॰ Si॰ ukte diSAM prAcItvAdijYAnasADanI prakAraBede sa ca tatrokto yaTA “vftte'mBaHsusamIkftakzitigate kendrasTaSaNkoH kramAqgAgraMyatra viSatyapEti ca yatastatrAparEndryO diSO । tatkAlApamajIvayostu vivarAdBAkarRamityA hatAllambajyAptamitANgulerayanadiSyEndI sPuwAM cAlitA । tanmatsyAdaTa yAmyasOmyakakuBO sOmyA Druve vA BavedekasmAdapi BAgratIBujamitAM kowImimAM SaNkutaH । nyasyedyazwimfjuM taTA Buvi yaTA yazwyagrayoH saMyutiH kowiH prAcyaparA Bavaditi kfte bAhuSca yAmyottarA” mU॰ “udakena samIkftAyAM BUmAvizwapamARaM vfttaM viliKya tasya kendre dvAdaSANgulaSaNku nivaSya tasya CAyA tasmin vftte yatra praviSati pUrvAhRe vA aparAhRe yato nirgacCati tatra paScimapUrvadiSO kila BavataH । parantu yasmin kAle CAyApraveSo jAto yasmin kAle ca nirgamastAtkAlikayorarkayoH krAntijye sADye । tayorantarAt tasyASCAyAyAH karRena muRitAllambajyayA BaktAdyallabDamaNgulAdi PalaM tenEndro diguttarataScAlitA sPuwA Bavati yadyuttare'yane ravirvarttate tadA uttarataH yadi dakziRe tadA dakziRataH । evaM sPuwA prAcI । anyaTA sTUletyarTaH । tanmatsyAdyAmyasOmyo diSO । aTa prakArAntareRAha । DruvamavalambasUtreRa vidDvA DruvABimuMKakIlakaH sOmyA । svasTAnakIlako yAmyA । tanmatsyAt pUrvApare । praTamaM BAcCAyAgradarSane digjYAnamuktam । idAnImaTavEkasmAdapi BAgrataH । taccEvam । aBIzwakAle SaNkorBAgraM cihnayitvA tasyASCAyAyA vakzyamARaprakAreRa BujaM kowiM cAnIya Bujakowimite SalAke gfhItvA SaNkumUlAdyaTAdiggatAM kowiSalAkAM CAyAgrAdvyastadiggatAM BujaSalAkAM ca taTA Buvi nyasedyaTA SalakAgrayoH saMyutiH syAt । evaM kfte sati kowiH prAcyaparA digBavati । bAhuSca yAmyottarA । atropapattiH । ahorAtravftte izwAnAmunnataGawikAnAmagre pUrvAhRe samapaRqalena yAvadantaraM tAvadevAparAhRe tAvatInAM GawInAmagre Bavati । atastacCAyAgrabinduByAM digjYAnamupapadyate । paraM tatkAlAntareRa yadarkakrAntyantaraM tenAntaritaM Bavati । atastat sanDeyam । taccEvam । tasmit kAle yAni karRavfttAgrANgulAni pUrvAhRe yAni cAparAhRe tezAmantaraM kAryam । tatra lAGavArTaM tatkAlakrAntyorevAntaraM kftam । tato'grAkaraRAyAnupAtaH । yadi lambajyAkowyA trijyA karRastadA krAntijyAntareRa kimiti । atra labDamagrAntaram । tato'nyo'nupAtaH । yadi trijyADyAsArDe etAvadantaraM tadA karRavyAsArDe kimiti । atra tulyatvAdguRakaBAjakayostrijyAnASe kfte satyupapannaM tatkAlApamajIvayostu vivarAdityAdi । yadyuttaramayanaM vartate uttarato'rke cAlite SaNkorBAgraM dakziRato yAti tadottarataScAlanIyam । ata upapannamEndrIsPuwA cAliteti । BujakowInAmupapattiragre । sanniveSamAtreRa digjYAnamiva darSitam” prami॰ ।
pu॰ diyAM tatsyalokamfpARAM jayaH । jigIzukfte yadDena 1 diksTitanfpajaye vidyayA 2 dikasTalokAdijaye ca । digvijavAdaBo'pyatra
m: दिग्—जय m. the conquest of various countries in all directions, Rājat. iv, 183 (cf. -विजय).

v: strI digaMSaSabde darSite si॰ Si॰ ukte diSAmaMSaBede ।
m: दिग्—ज्या f. the azimuth cosine of a place, Gaṇit.

दिग्—मण्डल see, दिङ्.
दिग्—नाग See दिङ्-.

v: pu॰ dikzu sTito vAraRaH । diggaje ErAvatAdO । “digvAraRamadAbilam” “praBinnadigvAraRavAhano vfzA” kumA॰ ।

s: [s] puM, (digeva vAso vastraM yasya .) SivaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 112 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 13 । 17 । 41 । “gaRakarttA gaRapatirdigvAsAH kAma eva ca ॥”) nagne, tri ॥ (yaTA, manuH । 11 । 202 । “snAtvAtuviprodigvAsAH prARAyAmena SuDyati ॥”)

of a grammarian, Gaṇar.

v: na॰ digBede vadanaM yasya । prAcyAdidigBedena tatrasTitamuKake rASiBede । “lagne digvadane'tidaRqagamanaM prAcyAdi SUlaM vinA” jyo॰ ta॰ rASInAM digaBedena suKamuktaM tatrEva । “mezAdyAstriBramAt jYeyAH prAgAdidiNmuKAstvamI” taTA ca mezaH prAgvadanaH, vfzoyAmIvadanaH, miTunaH paScimAmuKaH, karka uttarAmuKaH evaM siMhAdayaH DanurAdayaSca । didvaktradAdayo'pyatra ।

1. दिह् cl. 2. P. Ā. देग्धि, दिग्धे, Dhātup. xxiv, 5 (Subj. -देहत्, RV. vii, 50, 2; pf. दिदेह, दिदिहे, MBh.; fut. धेक्ष्यति, देग्धा, Siddh.; aor. अधिक्षत्, ˚त, 3. pl. ˚षुर्, JaimBr.; अदिग्ध, Pāṇ. vii, 3, 73) to anoint, smear, plaster, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.; Mn.; MBh.; R. &c.; increase, accumulate, L. : Caus. देहयति, ˚ते, MBh. &c.; aor. अदीदिहत्: Desid. दिधिक्षति, ˚ते; धीक्षते (ŚBr.), to wish to anoint one's self: Intens. देदिह्यते, देदेग्धि.
दिह् [Fr. orig. धिघ्; cf. θιγγάνω, ἔ-θιγ-ον, τεῖχος, τοῖχος; Lat. fingo, figulus, figura; Goth. deigan, gadigis; O. E. dāh; E. dough; Germ. Teig.]
2. दिह् See सु-.
a: दिह् — {c2c} U. (देग्धि, दिग्धे, दिग्ध; desid. दिधिक्षति) 1 To anoint, smear, plaster spread over; Bk. 3. 21, 17. 54. --2 To soil, defile, pollute; R. 16. 15. --3 To increase, augment.
दिह् — f. 1 Anointing, smearing. --2 Pollution, soiling.

kaTAmimAm । yaTA diSaH samutpannAH SrotreByaH pfTivIpate ! ॥ brahmaRaH sfjataH sfzwimAdisarge samutTite । cintABUnmahatI ko me prajAH sfzwA Darizyati ॥ evaM cintayatastasya avakASaM vrajatviha । prAdurbbaBUzuH SrotreByo daSa kanyA mahApraBAH ॥ pUrvvA ca dakziRA cEva pratIcI cottarA taTA । UrdDvADa eva zaRmuKyAH kanyA hyAsaMstadA nfpa ! Satakowipravistaram । vasyAnte svecCayA tuzwA uzyatAM mA vilambaTa । BarttFMSca vaH prayacCAmi sfzwvA rUpasvino'naGAH! । yaTezwaM gamyatAM deSo yasyA yo rocate'DanA । evamuktASca tAH sarvA yaTezwaM prayayustadA । brahmA sasarja tUrRaM tAn lokapAlAn mahAbalAn । dfzwvA tu lokapAlAMstu tAH kanyAH punarAhvayan । vivAhaM kArayAmAsa brahmA lokapitAmahaH । ekAmindrAya sa prAdAdagnaye'nyAM yamAya ca । nirftAya ca devAya varuRAya mahAtmane । vAyave DanadeSAya ISAnAya ca suvrataH । UrdDvaM svayamaDizWAya SezAyADo vyavasTitAm । evaM dattvA punarvrahmA tiTiM prAdAt diSAM punaH । daSamIM BarttfnAmnastu ardDanAmnodDaran praBuH । tataH praBfti tA devyaH sendrAdyAH parikIrttitAH” ।

a: दिलीपः — A king of the Solar race, son of अंशुमत् and father of भगीरथ, but according to Kālidāsa, of रघु. [He is described by Kālidāsa as a grand ideal of what a king should be. His wife was Sudakṣiṇā, a woman in every respect worthy of her husband; but they had no issue. For this he went to his family priest Vasiṣṭha who told him and his wife to serve the celestial cow Nandinī. They accordingly served her for 21 days and were on the 22nd day favoured by the cow. A glorious boy was then born who conquered the whole world and became the founder of the line of the Raghus.]

2. दिव् cl. 4. दीव्यति, ˚ते, RV.; Br. &c. (perf. दिदेव, AV.; fut. देविष्यति; cond. अदेविष्यत्, MBh.; Daś.; aor. अदेवीत्, MBh.; &c.; inf. देवितुम्, MBh. &c.; ind.p. देवित्वा, Pāṇ. i, 2, 18; -दीव्य, RV. x, 42, 9) to cast, throw, esp. dice i.e. play, gamble (अक्षैस्, RV. x, 34, 13; MBh. iii, 2260; अक्षान्, Pāṇ. i, 4, 43), with (instr. MBh. ii, 2509), for (instr., ii, 2061 &c.; acc. MaitrS. i, 6, 11; ŚBr. v, 4, 4, 23; dat. MBh. iv, 534; ii, 2468; gen. [शतस्य] Pāṇ. ii, 3, 58); to lay a wager, bet with (सार्धम्), upon (dat.), MBh. i, 1192; to play, sport, joke, trifle with (acc. AV. v, 29); to have free scope, spread, increase (Pañc. ii, 193, B. वर्धति); to shine, be bright [Zd. dīv; (?) Lit. dyvas] BhP. iii, 20, 22; to praise, rejoice, be drunk or mad; to sleep; to wish for; to go, Dhātup. : Caus. देवयति, to cause to play (Sch.) or to sport, BhP. iii, 20, 22 : Desid. दिदेविषति and दुद्यूषति, Pāṇ. vii, 2, 49, Kāś. : Caus. of Desid. दुद्यूषयति, to incite to play, Bhaṭṭ. v, 49 : Intens. देदिवीति, देद्येति, देदेति &c., Vop. xx, 17.

3. दिव्, द्यु (nom. द्यौस्; voc. द्यौस् [RV. vi, 51, 5; AV. vi, 4, 3]; acc. द्याम्, दिवम्; instr. दिवा or दिवा [see below]; dat. दिवे [द्यवे, MBh. i, 3934]; abl. gen. दिवस् [rarely द्योस्, e.g. RV. iv, 27, 3; i, 115, 5] ; loc. दिवि, द्यवि; du. द्यावा s.v. [द्यवी as voc. only, iv, 56, 5]; pl. nom. द्यावस् [दिवस् only, ix, 118, 11]; acc. द्यून् [rare, दिवस्, दिवस्, e.g. i, 194, 2; iv, 3, 8]; instr. द्युभिस्; native grammarians give as stems दिव् and द्यो; the latter is declined through all cases like गो, but really does not occur except in forms mentioned above and in द्यो-सलिल, MBh. viii, 4658, while दिव् and द्यु regularly alternate before vow. and cons.) m. (rarely f.) in Ved., f. in later Skr. heaven, the sky (regarded in Ved. as rising in three tiers [अवम, मध्यम, उत्तम or तृतीय, RV. v, 60, 6 &c.], and generally as the father (द्यौष् पिता, while the earth is the mother [cf. द्यावा-पृथिवी], and Uṣas the daughter), rarely as a goddess, daughter of Prajā-pati, AitBr. iii, 33; ŚBr. i, 7, 4, 1);
m. (rarely n.) day (esp. in pl. and in such forms as दिवा), by day (cf. s.v.)
द्यवि-द्यवि, daily, every day
अनु द्यून्, day by day, daily
द्युभिस् and उप द्युभिस्, by day or in the course of days, a long time, RV.
brightness, sheen, glow (only द्युभिस्), RV. i, 53, 4; iii, 3, 2 &c.
fire (nom. द्युस्), L.

(दीव्यति, द्यूत or द्यून; desid. दुद्यूषति, दिदेविषति) 1 To shine, be bright. --2 To throw, cast (as a missile); Bk. 17. 87, 5. 81. --3 To gamble, play with dice (with acc or instr. of the ‘dice’); अक्षैरक्षान्वा दीव्यति Sk.; Śi. 8. 32; Ve. 1. 13. --4 To play, sport. --5 To joke, trifle with, make sport of, rally; (with acc.). --6 To stake, make a bet. --7 To sell. deal in (with gen.); अदेवीद्वंधुभीगानां Bk. 8. 122; (but with acc. or gen. when the root is preceded by a preposition; शतं शतस्य वा परिदीव्यति Sk.). --8 To squander, make light of. --9 To praise. --10 To be glad, rejoice. --11 To be mad or drunk. --12 To be sleepy. --13 To wish for. {vII.v} {c1c} P., {c10c} U. (देवति, देवयति-ते) 1 To cause to lament, pain, vex, torment. --2 To ask, beg. {vIII.v} {c10c} A. (देवयते) To suffer pain, lament, moan. --WITH परि to lament, moan, suffer pain; Bk. 4. 34.

दिव् — f. [दीव्यत्यत्र दिव्-बा ˚आधारे डिवि Tv.] (Nom. sing. द्यौः) 1 The heaven; R. 3. 4, 12; Me. 30. --2 The sky. --3 A day. --4 Light, brilliance. --5 Fire, glow of fire. N. B. The compounds with दिव् as first member are mostly irregular; e. g. दिवस्पतिः an epithet of Indra; अनतिक्रमणीया दिवस्पतेराज्ञा Ś. 6. दिवस्पृथिव्यौ heaven and earth. दिविजः, दिविष्ठः, दिविस्थः, दिविस (ष) द् m., दिवोकस् m., दिवौकस्, --सः ‘inhabitant of the heaven’, a god; Ś. 7; R. 3. 19, 47; दिविषद्रवृंदैः Gīt. 7. दिवस्पृश् m. the Supreme Being. दिविस्पृश् a. reaching or pervading the sky. दिवोद्भवा cardamoms. दिवोल्का a meteor. दिवौकस् m. {1} a god. {2} the Cātaka bird. {3} a deer. {4} a bee. {5} an elephant.

द्योदिवौ द्वे स्त्रियामभ्रं व्योम पुष्करमम्बरम्. नभोऽन्तरिक्षं गगनमनन्तं सुरवर्त्म खम्. वियद्विष्णुपदं वा तु पुंस्याकाशविहायसी। विहायसोऽपि नाकोऽपि द्युरपि स्यात्तदव्ययम्. तारापथोऽन्तरिक्षं च मेघाध्वा च महाबिलम्. विहायाः शकुने पुंसि गगने पुन्नपुंसकम्.।

a: दिवा — ind. By day, in the daytime; दिवाभू ‘to become day.’ --Comp. --अटनः a crow. --अंध a. blind by day. --(धः) an owl. --अंधकी, --अंधिका a musk-rat. --अवसानं ‘close of day’, evening. --करः {1} the sun; Ku. 1. 12, 5. 48. {2} a crow. {3} the sun-flower. --कीर्तिः {1} a Cāṇḍāla, a man of low caste. {2} a barber. {3} an owl. --चरः {1} a Cāṇḍāla. {2} a kind of bird (श्यामा). --निशं ind. day and night. --पुष्टः, --मणिः the sun. --प्रदीपः ‘a lamp by day’, an obscure man. --भीतः, --भीतिः {1} an owl; दिवाकराद्रक्षति यो गुहासु लीनं दिवाभीतमिवांधकारं Ku. 1. 12. {2} a white lotus (opening at night). {3} a thief, house-breaker. --मध्यं midday. --रात्रं ind. day and night. --वसुः the sun. --शय a. sleeping by day; R. 19. 34. --स्वप्नः, --स्वापः sleep during day-time. --(पः) an owl.

v: pu॰ divaH svargAta dAmIdAnaM yasmE । vaDraSvasya putraBede “vaDraSvAnmiTunaM yajYe menakAyAmiti SrutiH । divodrAmaSca rAjarzirahalyA ca yaSasvinI” harivaM॰ 32 a॰ । manurvaSye ripuYjayAsvye 2 nfpaBede ca tatkaTA kASIf॰ 47 a॰ । “tataScintayatA srazwvA dfzwo rAjarzisattamaH । avimukte mahAkzetre tapasyanniScalendriyaH । mamoranvayajo vIraH kzatroDarmEvIditaH । ripuYjayeti viKyAto rAjA parapuraYjayaH । aTa brahmA tamAsAdya bahugOravapUrvakam । uvAca vacanaM rAjan! ripuYjaya! mahAmate! । imAM pAlaya BUpAla! sasamudrAdikAnanAm । nAgakanyAM lAgarAjaH patnyarTante pradAsyati । anaNamohinInnAmnA vAsukiH SIlaBUzaRAma । divo'pi devAdAsyanti ratnAni kusumAni ca । prajApralanasantuzwA mahArAja! pratikzaRam । divodAsa iti KyAtamato nAma tvamApsyasi । matprasAdAcca nfpate! divyaM sAmarTyamastu te । paramezWivacaH SrutvA tato'sO rAjasattamaH । veDasaM bahuSaH stutvA vAkyaYcedamuvAca ha । rAjovAca । pitAmaha । mahAmAnya! trilokIkaraRakzama! । kaTannAnye ca rAjAno me kaTaM kaTyate tvayA । brahmovAca tvayi rAjyaM prakurvARe devovfzwiM viDAsyati । pApanizWe ca vE rAjYi na devo varzate punaH । rAjovAca yadyahaM pfTivInATaH sarvalokapitAmaha! । tadA divisado devA divitizWantu sA Buvi । devezu divi tizWatsu mayi tizWati BUtale । asapatyena rAjyena prajA sOKyamavApsyati! taTeti viSvasfkprokto divodAso nareSvaraH । pawaha GozayAYcakre divaM devA vrajantviti । mayi praSAsati kzORIM surAH KasTA Bavantviti । nAgacCantviha vE nAnA narAH susTA Bavantviti” ityupakrame divodAsyasya kASIto nirvAsanAntakaTA tata uttarEzu aDyAyezu dfSyA । 3 DanvantareravatAre kASIrAjaBede AyurvedaSabde tatkaTA 789 pf॰ suSrutaprAdurBAve BAva॰ pra॰ uktA dfSyA ।

s: klI, (dive vane Bavam । diva + yat .) lavaNgam । iti medinI । ye, 31 ॥ haricandanam । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ SapaTaH । tadBedA yaTA, divyatattve bfhaspatiH । “Dawo'gnirudakaYcEva vizaM kozaSca paYcamam । zazWaYca taRqulAH proktAH saptamaM saptamAzakam ॥ azwamaM PalamityuktaM navamaM DarmmajaM smftam । divyAnyetAni sarvvARi nirddizwAni svayamBuvA ॥” ezAM vivaraRaM tattacCabde kezAYcit parIkzASabde ca drazwavyam ॥ * ॥ gaNgAjalasparSapUrvvakaSapaTastratra miTyAkaTane dozaSca yaTA, -- “brahmaRo vacanaM SrutvA jYAneSo jYAninAMvaraH । gaNgAtoyaM kare kftvA svIkAraYca cakAra saH ॥ gaNgAtoyamupaspfSya miTyA yadi vadejjanaH । sa yAti kAlasUtraYca yAvadbE brahmaRo vayaH ॥” iti brahmavEvartte prakftiKaRqam ॥ * ॥ gaNgAjalAdisparSapUrvvakaSapaTe dozo yaTA । “taTA gaNgodakaM tAmraM gomayaM gorajastaTA । satyaM vA yadi vAsatyaM yadi divyaM karoti yaH ॥ karttA ca rOravaM yAti taTA kArayitA priye ! । uBayoH punarAvfttirnarayonizu nAsti vE ॥ tasyAsti punarAvfttirvyAGraSUkarayonizu । divyaM karttuH kArayiturjapapUjA vfTA yaTA ॥ gAyattrIrahitasyApi narakaYcottarottaram ॥” iti gAyattrItantre paYcamapawalaH ॥

v: tri॰ divi BavaH yat । 1 svargaBave 2 AkASaBave 3 utpAtaBede pu॰ “saMsUcayanti divyAntarIkzaBOmAstadutpAtAH” vf॰ saM॰ uktam utpAtaSabde 1123 pf॰ dfSyam । 4 yame 5 guggulO ca pu॰ rAjani॰ । kAlIvilAsatantrokte 6 BAvaBede “SfRu BAvatrayaM devi! divyavIrapaSukramAt । divyastu devavatprAyo vIraMScodDatamAnasaH । satyatretArdDaparyantaM divyaBAvavinirRayaH । tretAdvAparaparyantaM vIraBAva itIritam । madyaM matsyaM taTA mAMsaM mudrAM mETunameva ca । SmaSAnasAGanaM Badre! citAsADanameva ca । etatte kaTitaM sarvaM divyavIramataM priye । divyavIramataM nAsti kasvikAle sulocane!” । 7 nAyakaBede rasamaYjarI indrAdayo divyanAyakAH । 8 lavaNge na॰ medi॰ 9 haricandane na॰ rAjani॰ । 10 gaNgAjalAdisparSapUrvakaSapaTaBede “brAhmaRo vacanaM SrutvA jYAneSojYAninAM varaH । gaNgAtoyaM kare kftvA svIkAraYca cakAra saH । gaNgAtoyamupaspfSya miTyA yadi vradejjanaH । sa yAti kAlasUtraYca yAvadvE brahmaRovayaH” । brahma॰ vE॰ pra॰ Ka॰ । “taTA gaNgodakaM tAmraM gomayaM gorajastaTA । satyaM vA yadi vA'satyaM yadi divyaM karoti yaH । karttA । ca gOravaM yAti taTA kArayitvA priye! । uBayoH punarAvfttinarayonizu nAsti vE । tasyAsti punarAvfttirvyAGaSUkarayonizu । divyaM kartuH kArayiturjapapUjA vfTA taTA । gAyatrIrahitasyApi narakaYcottarottaram” iti gAyatrItantre 5 pawa॰ । vyavahAre pratijYAtArTasADanAya vAdiprativAdinoranyatarAByAM karttavye 11 lOkikasAkzyAdipramARAsadBAve tulAdiparIkzABede । tadBedAdiH tatra tyasAmAnyaviDicca vIrami॰ divyamAtfkAyAM darSito yaTA “tatra divyannAma mAnuzapramARABAve yannirRAyakaM yat taducyate । yattu smftitattve evakArasTale apiSabda dattvA mAnuzapramARasattve'pi yatra divyANgIkArastatrApi tadBavatIti prayojanamukta tadayuktam “ezAmanyatamABAve divyAnyatamamiti” vadatA yAjYavalkyena “pramARahIne vAde tu nirdozA dEvikI kriyeti” vadatA vfhaspatinA ca “yuktizvapyasamarTAsu SapaTErenamardayediti” nAradenApi mAnuzapramARAsattve eva divyasya viDAnAt । tatra॰ vfhaspatiH divyavedAnAha “Gawo'gnirudakarYcEva vizaM kozastu paYcamaH । Sarantu taRqulAH proktAH saptamantaptamAzakam । azwamaM PAlamityuktaM navamanDarmajantaTA । divyAnyetAni sarvARi nirdizwAni svayamBuveti” । nAradaH “yuktizvapyasamarTAsu SapaTErenamardayet । arTakAlabalApekza magnyambusukftAdiBiH । Dawo'gnirudakaM cEva vizaM koSastu paYcamaH । uktAnyetAni divyAni viSudDyarTaM mahAtmaBiH । sandigDe'rTe'BiyuktAnAM parIkzArTaM mahAtmanAm । prAktAni nAradeneha satyAnftaviSudDaye” iti । ardayetpIqayet । arTApekzatvaM sisADayizitArTasyAlpatvamahattvAnurUpamityarTaH । nanvezAmapi SapaTAnAM mAnuzapramARABAva eva nirRAyakatvena divyatvAt kaTaM divyAni navetyaBiDAnam । taTA ca SaNKaH “tatra divya nAma tulADAraRaM vizASanamapsu praveSo lohaDAraRamizwApUrttapradAnamanyAMSca SapaTAn kArayediti” । tAMSca SapaTAnAha vfhaspatiH “satyavAhanaSastrARi govIjakanakAni ca । devavrAhmaRapAdAMSca putradAraSirAMsi ca । ete ca SapaTAH proktAH svalpArTe sukarAH sadeti” । nArado'pi “satyavAhanaSastrARi gorIjakanakAni ca । devatApitfpAdAMSca dattAni sukftAni ca । spfSecCirAMsi putrARAM dArARAM suhfdAntaTA । aBiyogezu sarvezu koSapAnamaTApi vA । ityete SapaTAH proktA manunA svalpakAraRe” iti । satyam । atra samanantaraBAvinirRayanimittasya divyatvena vivakzitatvAt । tAdfSatvaYca GawAdInAmeva na tu SapaTAnAntezAM kAlAntaraBAvinirRayanimittatvAt । nanvevaM koSasya kaTantezu grahaRamiti cet satyam । tasya tezu pAzWomahABiyogavizayakatvasAmyAt sAvazwamBABiyogavizayatvasAmyAcca । vastutastu SapaTAnAmapi mAradAdivacanAnusArAdgobalIvardanyAyena divyatvAByupagamena navaSabdasyopalakzaRatvAt । taTAca nAradaH “yuktizvapyasamarTAsu SapaTErenamadeyet । arTakAlabalApekzamagnyambusukftAdiBiH । Gawo'gnirudakaYcEva vizaM koSaSca paYcamaH । uktAnyetAni divyAni viSudDyarTaM mahAtmaBiH” । divyaM nAma tulArohaRam । pUrvAhRe koSaSudDirviDIyate । rAtrO tu paScime BAge vizaM deyaM suSItalamiti” । atra vizasya varzAsu nizeDAt siMharavAveva parIkzAmAtra nizeDAcca divyAntaraM siMhetaravarzAzvapi kurvanti । ataH “yAmyAyane harO supte sarvakarmARi varjayedityasya na vizayaH । taTA ca jyotize “siMhasTe makarasTe ca jIve cAstamite BfgO । malamAse na karttavyA parIkzA jayakANkziRA” । taTA “raviSudDO gurO cEva na Sukre'stagate punaH । siMhasTe ca ravO nEva parIkzA Sasyate buDEH । nAzwamyAM na caturdaSyAM prAyaScittaparIkzaRe । na parIkzADivAsaSca SaniBOmadine Bavet” । raviSudDO gurO cedityatra Sasyata iti SezaH taTA ca dIpikAyAm “na SukrAste'zwame'rke gurusahitaravO janmamAse'zwame'vde vizwO mAse malAKye kujaSanidivase janmatArAsu cATa । nAqInakzatrahIne gururavirajanInATatArAviSudDO prAtaH kAryyA parIkzA dvitanucaragrahAMSodaye Sastalagne” । iti । yadyapi divye vAraviSezaviDAnABAvastaTApi SizwAcArAdAdityavAre divyAni dAtavyAnIti mitAkzarAyAm । aTa drivyadeSAH tatra pitAmahaH । “prANmuKo niScalaH kAryaH SucO deSe DawaH sadA । indrasTAne saBAyAM vA rAjadvAre catuzpaTe” iti । DawagrahaRaM divyAntarasyApyupalakzaRam । indrasTAnagrahaRaYca prasidDadevatAyatanAntarasyApyupalakzaRam । ataeva divyamAtramupakramya nAradaH “saBArAjakuladvAre devAyatanacatvare” । vizayaviSeze indrasTAnAdInAM vyavasTAmAha । kAtyAyanaH “indrasTAne'BiSastAnAM mahApAtakinAM nfRAm । nfpadrohapravfttAnAM rAjadvAre prayojayet । prAtilomyaprasUtAnAM divyaM deyaYcatuzpaTe । ato'nyezu tu kAryyezu saBAmaDye vidurbuDA” iti । indrasTAne indraDvajapUrvasTAne । divyadeSAnAdare divyaM visaMvadatItyAha, nAradaH “adeSakAladattAni bahirvAsakftAni ca । vyaBicAraM sadarTezu kurvantIha na saMSayaH” । vAso jananivAsastasmAdvahizkftAni nirjanapradeSakftAnIti yAvat । ataeva pitAmahaH “pratyakzaM dApayeddivyaM rAjA vADiMkfto'pi vA । brAhmaRAnAM SrutavatAM prakftInAM taTEva ceti” । brAhmaRAnAM prakftayo'mAtyAstepAYcetyanvayaH । aTa dinavyasADAraRaviDistatra vfhaspatiH “snehAt kroDAlloBato vA BedamAyAnti sAkziRaH । viDidattasya divyasya na Bedo jAyate kvaciditi” । viDiSca pitAmahena darSitaH “divyezu sarvakAryyARi prAqvivAkaH samAcaret । aDvarezu yaTADvaryuH sopayAso nfpAjYayA । tata AvAhayeddevAn viDinAnena Darmavit । vAditra tUryaGozESca ganDamAlyAnulepanEH । prANmuKaH prAYjalirBUtvA prAqvivAkastato vadet । ehyehi BagavanDarma! asmindivye samAviSa । sahito lokapAlESca vasvAdityamarudgaREH । AvAhya tu Dawe DarmaM paScAdaNgAni vinyaset” । sarvakAryyARi sADAraRAni asADAraRAni ca tatastadupayogisAmagrIsampAdanAnantaramityarTaH । DawagrahaRamatra divyamAtropalakzaRam । asmindivya iti mantraliNgAdetezAM DarmARAM divyamAtrasAmyasya । “imaM mantraviDiM kftsnaM sarvadivyezu yojayet । AvAhanaYca devAnAM taTEva parikalpayet” ityupasaMharatA tenEvoktatvAcca । aNgAni kAnItyAkANkzAyAM sa evAha, “indraM pUrve tu vinyasya preteSaM dakziRe taTA । varuRaM paScime BAge kuveraM cottare taTA । agnyAdilokapAlAMSca koRaBAgezu vinyaset । indraH pIto yamaH SyAmo varuRaH sPawikapraBaH । kuverastu suvarRABaH agniScEva suvarRaBaH । taTEva nirftiH SyAmo vAyurDUmraH praSasyate । ISAnastu Bavedrakta evaM DyAyetkramAdimAn । indrasya dakziRe pArSve vasUnAsTApayedbuDaH । DaroDruvastaTA soma ApaScEvAnalo'nilaH । patyUzaSca praBAtaYca vasavo'zwO prakIrttitAH । deveSeSAnayormaDye AdityAnAM taTA'yanam । DAtAryamA ca mitraSca varuRAMSo BagastaTA । indro vivasvAn pUzA ca parjanyo daSamaH smftaH । tatastvazwA tato vizRurajaGanyo jaGanyajaH । ityete dvAdaSAdityA nAmamiH parikIrttitAH । agneH paScimaBAge tu rudrA ekAdaSa smftAH । vIraBadraSca SamBuSca giriSaSca mahAyaSAH । ajEkapAdahirbuGnyaH pinAkI cAparAjitaH । BuvanADISvaraScEva kapAlI ca viSAmpatiH । sTARurBavaSca BagavAn rudrAstvekAdaSa smftAH । preteSarakzomaDye ca mAtfsTAnaM prakalpayet । brAhmI mAheSvarI cEva kOmArI vEzRavI taTA । vArAhI cEva mAhendrI cAmuRqA gaRasaMyutA । nirfteruttare BAge gaReSAyatanaM viduH । varuRasyottare BAge marutAM sTAnamucyate । pavanaH sparSano vAyuranilo marutastaTA । prARAH prAReSajIvO ca maruto'zwO prakIrttitAH । GawasyottaraBAge tu durgAmAvAhayedbuDaH । etAsAM devatAnAntu svanAmnA pUjanaM viduH । BUzAvasAnaM DarmAya dattvAcArGAdikaM kramAt । arGAdi paScAdaNgAnAM BUzAntamupakalpayet । ganDAdikAM nivedyAntAM paricaryyAM prakalpayet । caturdikzu taTA homaH karttavyo vedapAragEH । Ajyena havizA cEva samidBirhomasADanEH । sAvitryA praRavenATa svAhAntenEva homayet” । aNgAnAm indrAdidargAntAnAm arTAdyupakalpanaYca na kARqAnusamayena । taTAtve prayogavacanAvagatANgasahaBAvabADApatteH । kintu padArTAnusamayena taTA ca durgAyE BUzaRa dattvA DarmAsyendAdidurgAntAnAYca ganDAdiparicayaM viprakalpayediti । gAyatrIM praRavAdrikAmuccAryya punaH praRavaM svAhAkArAntamuccAryya samidAjyacaruBiH pratyekamazwottaraSataM juhuyAt । “anuktasaNKyA yatra syAt SatamazwottaraM smftamiti” smaraRAdityarTaH । homAnantarakarttavyaM sa evAha “yamarTamaBiyuktaH syAlliKitvA tantu patrake । mantreRAnena sahitantat kAryaYca SiraH kramAt” । mantraSca “AdityacandrAvanilAnalO ca dyOrBUmirApo hfdayaM yamaSca । ahaSca rAtriSca uBeca sanDye DarmaSca jAnAti narasya vfttamiti” etat sarvaM pUrbAhRe karttavyam tasya praDAnakAlatvAt taTA ca nAradaH “ahorAtrozite snAte ArdravAsasi mAnave । pUrvAhRe sarvadivyAnAM pradAnamanukIrttitamiti” । etat prAqvivAkenopavAsAdiniyamapUrvakaM karttavyam taTA ca nAradaH “prAqvivAkastato vipro vedavedANgapAragaH । SrutavfttopasampannaH SAntacitto vimatsaraH । satyasanDaH SucirdakzaH sarvaprARihite rataH । upozitaScArdravAsAH kftadantAnuDAvanaH । sarvAsAM devatAnAYca pujAM kftvA yaTAviDi” । karturupavAsAdikamAha “trirAtropozitoyaH syAdekarAtropozitastu vA । nityaM deyAni divyAni Sucaye sArdravAsase” iti । yAjYavalkyo'pi “sacelaM snAtamAhUya sUryyodaya upozitam । kArayetsarvadivyAni nfpavrAhmaRasanniDAviti” । atra sUryyodayapadena pUrvAhRa eva grAhyaH “pUrvAhRe sarvadivyAnAM pradAnamanukIrttitamiti” nAradavacanAnuroDAt । trirAtrEkarAtrIpavAsayoH SaktASaktavizayatvena vyavasTA jYeyA । divyaprayogAnantaraM dakziRAdAnam uktena viDinA divyaprayogaM kArayituH rAjYaH PalaYcAha pitAmahaH “sidBiH parivfto rAjA SudDimetAM prapUjayet । ftvikpurIhitAcAryyAn dakziRABistu tozayet । evaM kArayitA rAjA BuktvA BogAnmanoramAn । mahatIM kIrttimApnoti brahmaBUyAya kalpate” iti । ayaYca viDiH sarvadivyasADAraRa ityAha sa eva “imaM mantraviDiM kftsnaM sarvadivyezu yojayet । AvAhanaYca devAnAM taTEva parikIrttitamiti” । sarvadevAvAhanAdi saMSoDyaSirasi patrAropaRAntaM sarvadivyasADAraRamityarTaH” divyamAtfkA । 12 jalaBede । “divyaM caturviDaM proktaM DArAjaM karakABavam । tOzAraYca taTA hEmaM tezu DAraM guRADikam” BAva॰ pra॰ । 13 snAnaBede na॰ “asAmarTyAcCarIrasya kAlaSaktyAdyapekzayA । mantrasnAnAditaH sapta kecidicCanti sUrayaH । mAntraM BOmaM taTAgneyaM vAyavyaM divyameva ca । vAruRaM mAnasaYcEva saptasnAnaM prakIrtitam । “ApohizWeti” vE mAntraM, mfdAlamBantu pArTivam । AgneyaM BasmanA snAnaM, vAyavyaM gorajaH smftam । yattu sAta pavarzeRa snAnaM taddivyamucyate । vAruRaYcAvagAhyaYca, mAnasa vizRucintanam । samastaM snAnamuddizwaM mantrasnAnakrameRa tu । kAladozAdasAmarTyAt sarvaM tasya PalaM smftam” yogiyAjYavalkyaH । divi dyotAtmake Aditye paramavyomni vA दिव्य [cf. Gk. δῖος for διϝιος; Lat. dīus for divius in sub dīo.]
a: दिव्य — a. [दिवि भवः यत्] 1 Divine, heavenly, celestial. --2 Supernatural, wonderful; परदोषेक्षणदिव्यचक्षुषः Śi. 16. 29; Bg. 11. 8. --3 Brilliant, splendid. --4 Charming, beautiful. --व्यः 1 A superhuman or celestial being; दिव्यानामपि कृतविस्मयां पुरस्तात् Śi. 8. 64. --2 Barley. --3 An epithet of Yama. --4 A fragrant resin, bdellium. --5 A philosopher. --व्यं 1 Celestial nature, divinity. --2 The sky. --3 An ordeal (of which 10 kinds are enumerated); cf. Y. 2. 22, 95. --4 An oath, a solemn declaration. --5 Cloves. --6 A kind of sandal. --7 A kind of water. --Comp. --अंशुः the sun. --अंगना, --नारी, --स्त्री a heavenly nymph, celestial damsel, an apsaras. --अदिव्य a. partly human and partly divine (as a hero, such as Arjuna). --उदकं rainwater. --उपपादुकः a god. --ओषधिः f. a herb of great supernatural efficacy, i. e. curing snake-poison; Mu. 1. 21. --कारिन् a. {1} taking an oath. {2} undergoing an ordeal. --गंधः sulphur. --(धा) large cardamoms. --(धं) cloves. --गायनः a Gandharva. --चक्षुस् a. {1} having divine vision, heavenly-eyed; R. 3. 45. {2} blind. (--m.) a monkey. (--n.) a divine or prophetic eye, supernatural vision, the power of seeing what is invisible by the human eye. --ज्ञानं supernatural knowledge. --दृश् m. an astrologer. --दोहदं a present offered to a deity for the accomplishment of one's desired object. --पुष्पः the Karavīra tree. --प्रश्नः inquiry into celestial phenomena or future course of events, augury. --मानं measuring the time according to the days and years of the gods. --मानुषः a demi-god. --रत्नं a fabulous gem said to grant all desires of its possessor, the philosopher's stone; cf. चिंतामणि. --रथः a celestial car moving through the air. --रसः {1} quicksilver. {2} heavenly water or love; V. 2. --वस्त्र a. divinely dressed. --(स्त्रः) {1} sunshine. {2} a kind of sun-flower. --वाक्यं a celestial word or voice. --श्रोत्रं an ear which hears everything. --सरित् f. the celestial Ganges. --सानुः N. of one of the Viśvedevas. --सारः the Śāla tree.

v: na॰ kAmarUpapIWasTakzoBakaSElapUrvaBAgasTe kuRqaviSeze । “yaTA taddakziRe mahASElaH kzoBakonAmanAmataH । tasmin girO SilApfzWavaktredevI vyavasTitA । paYcapuzkariRI nAmnA praYcayonisvarUpiRI । ekatra paYcaBirdurgA yoniBiH paYcavaktrakam । sTitA ramayituM tatra nityameva himAdrijA । tacCElapUrvaBAgAttu kAntA nAma mahAnadI । dakziRaM sAgaraM yAti praTamAM cottarasravA । divyakuRqaM mahAkuRqaM tacCElopatyakAgatma । saMsTitastatra snAtvA tu tAM devIM paripUjayet । divyakuRqe naraH snAtvA paYcapuzkariRIM SivAm । yaH pUjayenmahABAgaH sa yonO na hi jAyate” । kAli॰ pu॰ 81 a॰
m: दिव्य—कुण्ड n. N. of a lake, KālP.

s: strI, (divyA vanaBavA latA .) mUrvvAlatA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥

m: दिव्य—पुष्प m. Nerium Odorum, L.

s: strI, (divyA yamunA tattulyaPalapradatvAt .) kAmarUpe damanikAyA nadyAH pUrvvaBAgasTasaridbiSezaH । yaTA, -- “tasyA nadyAH pUrvvaBAge gaNgeva PaladAyinI । mAGantu sakalaM mAsaM tasyAM snAtvA narottamaH ॥ taTA damanikAyAYca paraM nirvvARamApnuyAt । tataH pUrvve parA devI nAmnA sA sariduttamA ॥ mahatI divyayamunA yamunAvat PalapradA । dakziRAdrisamudBUtA dakziRodaDigAminI ॥ tasTAntu kArttikaM mAsaM snAtvA mokzamavApnuyAt ॥” iti kAlikApurARe 81 aDyAyaH ॥
v: strI nityakarma॰ । kAmarUpapIWasTadamanikAyA nadyAH pUrvaBAgasTe nadIBede yaTA “tasyA nadyAH pUrvaBAne gaNgeva PaladAyinI । mAGantu sakalaM mAsaM tasyAM snAtvA narottamaH । taTA damanikAyAYca paraM nirvARa mApnuyAt । tataH pUrve parA devI nAmnA sA sariduttamA । mahatI divyayamunA yamunAvatPalapradA । dakziRAdrisamudBUtA dakziRodaDigAminI । tasyAntu kArtikaM mAsaM snAtvA mokzamavApnuyAt” kAli॰ pu॰ 81 a॰

k.v: अहङ्कारवानहंयुः शुभंयुस्तु शुभान्वितः। दिव्योपपादुका देवा नृगवाद्या जरायुजाः॥

v: tri॰ deya + pfzo॰ । deve “BuvadvasurdiyAnAM patiH” f॰ 8 । 19 । 37 ।
m: दिय mfn. deserving of gifts (= देय, or दानार्ह, Durga on Nir. iii, 15), RV. viii, 19, 37

दियानाम् पति lord of gifts, a very liberal man.

a: दिष्णुः — A giver, donor.

v: pu॰ 6 ta॰ । 1 BAgyasamAptO tadupalakzite 2 maraRe ca । “tato dizwAntamApannaH sarvezAM duHKamAvahan” BA॰ A॰ 49 a॰ “dizwAntamApsyati BavAnapi putraSokAt” raGuH

BAgyam । ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 28 ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 14 । 53 । 16 । “tataste niGanaM prAptAH sarvve sasutabAnDavAH । na dizwamatyatikrAntuM SakyaM budDyA balena vA ॥” diSa + karmmaRi ktaH .) upadizwe, tri । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ (kaTite ca । yaTA, BawwO । 2 । 32 । “gADeyadizwaM virasaM rasantaM rAmo'pi mAyAcanamastracuYcuH ॥”)

puM, (diSatIti । diSa + saMjYAyAM ktaH .) kAlaH । ityamaraH । 1 । 4 । 1 ॥ (vEvasvatamanoH puttraviSezaH । yaTA, BAgavate । 8 । 13 । 2 । “narizyanto'Ta nABAgaH saptamo dizwOcyate ॥”) dAruharidrA । iti SabdamAlA ॥
v: tri॰ diSa--karmmaRi kta । 1 upadizwe 2 kaTite । saMjYAyAM karttari kta । 3 BAmye na॰ amaraH । “na dizwamizwaM kurute na tizWati tu pOruze” vizRu pu॰ । 4 kAle pu॰ amaraH । 5 vEvasvatamanoH putraBede । “narizyanto'TanABAgaH saptamI dizwa ucyate” BAga॰ 8 । 13 । 3 vEvasvatamanuputrakaTane । 6 dAruharidrAyAM SabdamAlA
m: दिष्ट mfn. shown, pointed out, appointed, assigned (दिष्टा गतिस्, ‘the appointed way’ i.e. death, R. ii, 103, 8)
fixed, settled
directed, bidden, RV.; AV.; MBh.; R. &c.

a sort of Curcuma, L.

aim, goal, TBr. ii, 4, 2, 2 &c.
allotment, assignment, decree
fate, destiny, AV. x, 3, 16; MBh.
direction, order, command, BhP. v, 1, 11 &c.; Rājat. iv, 121
a description according to space and time (i.e. of a natural phenomenon), Sāh.
a: दिष्ट — p. p. [दिश् कर्मणि-क्त] 1 Shown, indicated, assigned, pointed out. --2 Described, referred to. --3 Fixed, settled. --4 Directed, ordered &c. --ष्टः Time. --ष्टं 1 Assignment, allotment. --2 Fate, destiny, good or ill-luck; भो दिष्टं Ś. 2. --3 Order, direction, command. --4 Aim, object. --Comp. --अंतः ‘the end of one's appointed time’, death; दिष्टांतमाप्स्यति भवानपि पुत्रशोकात् R. 9. 79.

k.v: कालो दिष्टोऽप्यनेहापि समयोऽप्यथ पक्षतिः।  प्रतिपद्द्वे इमे स्त्रीत्वे तदाद्यास्तिथयो द्वयोः॥
दैवं दिष्टं भागधेयं भाग्यं स्त्री नियतिर्विधिः। हेतुर्ना कारणं बीजं निदानं त्वादिकारणम्.।

m: दिष्ट—भाव m. ‘appointed state’ i.e. death, MBh. v, 4529.
दिष्ट—भुज् mfn. reaping the appointed results of one's works, BhP. vii, 13, 39.
दिष्ट—दृश् mfn. looking at fate or at one's lot, BhP. iv, 21, 22.
दिष्ट-गमन n. dying, death (cf. दिष्टा गतिः), HirP.
दिष्ट—कारिन् mfn. executing an order or acting according to fate, BhP. iv, 28, 1.
दिष्ट—पर mfn. relying on fate, fatalist, MBh. iii, 1214.

s: strI, (diSa + ktin saMjYAyAM ktic vA .) harzaH । parimARam । iti medinI । we, 18 ॥
v: strI diSa--BAve ktin sajYAyAM karttariM ktic vA । 1 harze 2 parimARe ca medi॰ । 3 kaTane upadeSe 4 utsave “taTAcAsya dizwivfviBiva SuSrAva” kAda॰ । 5 BAgye ca “rAjakule dizwivfdDisagpru mImahAnaBUt” kAda॰ ।

auspicious juncture, good fortune, happiness (esp. instr. ˚ट्या, thank heaven! I congratulate you on your good luck! often with वर्धसे, you are fortunate), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a kind of measure of length, Kauś., Sch. on KātyŚr.
a: दिष्टिः — f. [दिश् भावे क्तिन्, संज्ञायां कर्तरि क्तिच् वा] 1 Assignment, allotment. --2 Direction, command, instruction, rule, precept. --3 Fate, fortune, destiny. --4 Good fortune, happiness, any auspicious event (such as the birth of a son); दिष्टिवृद्धिमिव शुश्राव K. 55; दिष्टिवृद्धिसंभ्रमो महानभूत् K. 70. --5 A sort of measure of length.

m: दिष्टि—वृद्धि f. congratulation, Kād.; Hcar.

s: vya, (diSatIti sampadAditvAt BAve kvip diSam । deSanaM styAyati । styE + kvip । zwutvam । saMjYApUrvvakatvAt jaStvaM na । yadbAM, diSatIti । diSa + “aGnyAdiByaSceti .” yakpratyayena sADuH .) AnandaH । ityamaraH । 3 । 4 । 10 ॥ BAgyena । yaTA, -- “dizwyAmba ! te kukzigataH paraH pumAn ॥” iti SrIBAgavatam ॥
v: avya॰ diSa--sampadA॰ mAve kvip diSaM deSanaM styAyati styE--zwyE--vA kvip aGnyAdi॰ ni॰ vA । 1 harze 2 maNgale BAgyArTakadizwiSabdasya tftoyAntasya rUpamityanye tena 3 BAgyenetyarTe । “anyo'nyagatasOhArdA dizwyAdizwyeti cAtruvan” BA॰ A॰ 129 a॰
a: दिष्ट्या — ind. (Strictly the instr. sing. of दिष्टि) Fortunately, luckily, thank God, how glad I am, how fortunate, bravo; (an exclamation of joy or gratulation); दिष्ट्या प्रतिहतं दुर्जातं Māl. 4; दिष्ट्या सोयं महाबाहुरंजनानंदवर्धनः U. 1. 32; Ve. 2. 12. (दिष्ट्या वृध् means ‘to be congratulated upon’; as in दिष्ट्या धर्मपत्नीसमागमेन पुत्रमुखदर्शनेन चायुष्मान्वर्धते Ś. 7).

k.v: दिष्ट्या समुपजोषं चेत्यानन्देऽथान्तरेऽन्तरा। अन्तरेण च मध्ये स्युः प्रसह्य तु हठार्थकम्.।
